description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Messaging service. It includes method annotations for various API calls related to channel operations like creating, deleting, describing, and listing channels, as well as managing memberships, messages, and configurations.

classes.name: ChimeSDKMessagingClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with the Amazon Chime SDK Messaging service, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: associateChannelFlow
methods.description: Associates a channel flow with a channel.

methods.name: batchCreateChannelMembership
methods.description: Adds multiple members to a channel in batch.

methods.name: describeChannel
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific channel.

methods.name: sendChannelMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a channel.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource with key-value pairs.

methods.name: updateChannel
methods.description: Updates the details of a channel.

methods.name: updateChannelMessage
methods.description: Updates a message in a channel.

methods.name: updateChannelReadMarker
methods.description: Updates the read marker for a channel.
